{{Infobox place|name=New-Ash|type=Seat of [[House Phoenix]]|region=[[the Burnt Road]], edge of [[the Ash Fields]]|house=[[House Phoenix]]|notable=The endlessly rebuilt castle; the pyre-ground; no portraits, no graves}}
'''New-Ash''' stands on scorched ground where nothing grows — the purest soil, says [[House Phoenix]], ready for anything. The castle is torn down and rebuilt every generation; a visitor who returns twice never sees the same house. At its center lies '''the pyre-ground''', where the yearly bonfire is lit — built directly atop what may be the oldest ash in the realm. There are no portraits and no graves.
{{House Phoenix}}
